acceptance_predicates.description: Space visibly toggles the focused available agent and select-all visibly selects the allowed catalog set.
Enter advances only with a valid nonempty agent selection; empty Enter keeps the Agent route active and gives concise actionable feedback.
Formal transition model, renderer, contextual hot-key/help catalog, and runtime tests agree for every Agent-step key outcome.
Search, multi-selection, unavailable options, draft restoration, and compatibility filtering remain catalog-bound with no inferred or free-form agent.
PTY or equivalent runtime coverage proves visible selection, guarded Enter continuation, context help, resize, and cleanup.

definition_of_done: An operator can unambiguously select agents and understand why continuation is blocked.
The checked formal model and UI tests prevent selection/continuation regressions.
Independent review, signed-DCO merge, and exact-main CI pass.

inputs.description: Existing catalog-backed wizard and formal state model.

outputs.description: Explicit checked keyboard contract for Agent-step selection and continuation.
Visible interaction regression coverage for installed/PTY-capable TUI execution.

gates.description: Formal/model, renderer, help-catalog, and runtime keyboard regression matrix passes.
Independent exact-head review, signed-DCO merge, and exact-main UI-quality checks pass.
